title: deserialize_header enforces RFC 8621 §4.4.1 1-2 element constraint at wire boundary
description: The header field of EmailFilterCondition has a custom deserialize_with that rejects 0 or 3+ element arrays with an error citing the RFC section. This is the right place to catch this: at the wire boundary during deserialization, not buried in method handler logic. A contributor might suggest removing the validation as 'over-engineering for a types crate' — but invalid input that reaches method handlers without validation generates confusing failures far from the source. The error message includes the RFC section number, which is precisely what a debugger needs.
